=====================================
File Tab Opener (macOS) - Read Me
=====================================

[Version] 1.0.0
[Type] Freeware

[Overview]
A native macOS application for managing and opening folders as Finder tabs.
Group folders by project and open them all as Finder tabs with one click.

[System Requirements]
- macOS 12 (Monterey) or later
- Apple Silicon / Intel Mac supported
- Accessibility permission required

[Installation]
1. Drag FileTabOpenerM.app to your Applications folder
2. Launch the app
3. Grant Accessibility permission when prompted
   (System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility)

[Key Features]
- Tab group management (create, rename, copy, delete, reorder)
- One-click open all folders as Finder tabs
- Modern layout (sidebar + detail panel) and Classic layout
- Folder history with pin support
- Window position/size save and restore
- Automatic dark mode support
- 5 languages (English, Japanese, Korean, Traditional/Simplified Chinese)

[Configuration]
~/Library/Application Support/FileTabOpenerM/config.json
* Compatible with the Python version (file_tab_opener)

[Uninstall]
Simply delete the app from your Applications folder.
To also remove settings:
  rm -rf ~/Library/Application\ Support/FileTabOpenerM
  rm -rf ~/Library/Logs/FileTabOpenerM
